|----------|---------|

| **`grep`** | Search for a pattern inside a file. |
| **`ls`** | List directory contents. |
| **`mkdir`** | Create a new directory. |
| **`mv`** | Move or rename a file/directory. |
| **`pwd`** | Show the current working directory. |
| **`rm`** | Delete a file. |
| **`rmdir`** | Remove an empty directory. |
| **`tail`** | Show the last few lines of a file. |
| **`touch`** | Create an empty file. |
| **`wc`** | Count lines, words, or characters in a file. |
| **`sort`** | Alphabetically sort the lines of a file. |

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| **`authenticate_twitter`** | Log in a user. |

| **`search_tweets`** | Search tweets by keyword. |

| **`get_tweet_comments`** | Get all comments for a tweet. |
| **`follow_user` / `unfollow_user`** | Manage following relationships. |
| **`list_all_following`** | List all users the authenticated account follows. |
| **`get_user_stats`** | Retrieve statistics for a user. |
